sentences.en: A significant quantity of mercury was found in the mackerel.
sentences.zh: 鲭鱼中发现有大量的水银。

sentences.en: Mercury is the fastest planet to go around the sun.
sentences.zh: 金星是绕太阳运行最快的行星。

sentences.en: Mercury and the Moon are both covered in impact craters.
sentences.zh: 水星和月球表面都有撞击坑覆盖。

senses.zh: 水星；墨丘利（罗马十二主神之一）
（mercury）汞，水银；（温度计）水银柱；<古>信使
